name: RankYak – AI SEO Agent for Autoblogging
author: RankYak

sections.description:
RankYak‘s AI agents automate your SEO growth: they find low-competition keywords, create a monthly content plan, and automatically write and publish SEO-optimized articles that drive traffic and boost your ranking.

✨ RankYak Features:

  • Automatic keyword research: Once you connect your website, RankYak will start researching keywords based on your website, target audience, and industry.
  • Monthly content plan: A monthly content plan for related keywords is automatically generated, view the keywords and adjust if needed.
  • High-quality article every day: Every day, an SEO-optimized article is generated for the planned keyword.
  • Internal and external linking: Relevant internal and external links are automatically added to the articles, improving your website’s authority and relevance.
  • Featured images: A featured image is automatically generated for each article, enhancing its visual appeal.
  • Automatically published: Your articles are automatically published to your website every day so you can just sit back and watch your traffic increase.

Review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more details.
sections.installation:
With the RankYak WordPress plugin, you can easily connect your WordPress site to RankYak and start automating your SEO growth. It allows RankYak to automatically publish the SEO-optimized articles to your WordPress site, helping you to boost your traffic and rankings effortlessly.

Before you start

Make sure you have a RankYak account and set up your website in RankYak. If you don’t have an account yet, you can sign up for free at RankYak.

Installing the plugin

  • Log in to the WordPress admin panel. Select Plugins > Add Plugin.
  • Search for RankYak.
  • Select Install Now > Activate.
  • You will be redirected to the plugin setup page.
  • Click on Connect RankYak and select your project.

RankYak will now automatically start publishing SEO-optimized articles to your WordPress site.

Contact us

Contact us via support@rankyak.com for support.
sections.faq:
What is RankYak?

RankYak is an AI-powered SEO automation platform that helps you grow your website traffic and rankings effortlessly. It automates keyword research, content planning, and article writing, allowing you to focus on other aspects of your business.

How are the articles generated?

RankYak starts with keyword research based on your website, target audience, and industry. A monthly content plan is generated with related keywords that have good potential. Every day, an SEO-optimized article is generated for the planned keyword. The AI will optimize the article to maximize it’s value and publish it to your website automatically.

Are the articles SEO-optimized?

Yes, the articles are SEO-optimized. All articles are generated with SEO in mind, including meta data, heading structure, keyword density, and internal and external linking. This will help you rank higher on search engines and increase your organic traffic.

How many articles are generated per month?

RankYak generates one SEO-optimized article every day, adding up to a full month of fresh content for your website.

Do I need a RankYak account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a RankYak account to use this plugin. The plugin connects your WordPress site to your RankYak account, allowing RankYak to automatically publish SEO-optimized articles to your site.
